message: The other day, I was explaining to my grandkids why we need to stock up on supplies before a storm hits. They looked at me like I was suggesting we start a potato gun competition instead. I guess they thought I was being a bit dramatic. But when the skies turned dark and the wind started howling, they suddenly became very interested in the flashlight I’d tucked away. It’s funny how a little preparation can turn me from the ‘crazy old lady’ into the ‘wise grandparent’ in just a few minutes. Maybe next time, I’ll show them the list of items we keep handy—it might just impress them! 🌪️
